podcast.body: "Big Takeover," a song by the legendary punk band Bad Brains, provided several sampled elements for the Beastie Boys' 1992 track "Pass the Mic." These samples are heard approximately ten seconds into the Beastie Boys' song, demonstrating the influence of punk on later alternative and hip-hop acts through sampling. "Ten seconds later, we hear the first of several elements taken from Big Takeover, a song by the legendary punk band Bad Brains."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
